build_pipeline_detector: build a CuPiK Pipeline with detector steps to find changepoints and outliers in time series data
build_pipeline_transformer: build a CuPiK Pipeline with transformer steps to extract TsFeatures from time series data
build_pipeline_model: build a CuPiK Pipeline with model steps to fit time series forecasting models sequentially
run_pipeline_fit: run the Pipeline fit method on univariate or multivariate time series data with optional outlier removal
fit_sklearn_model: fit an sklearn model on tabular features extracted from time series data using TsFeatures
